{{Quote|It should come as no surprise to you that Kerrin almost wiped the GH7 security matrix computers today. Why we don't just boot him out the docking ring airlock is beyond me. Could you make sure the backup defense database is still intact? It would be a huge weight off my mind.|A memo from Z|<ref name="Defensive" />}}
'''Z''' was a member of the [[InterStellar Regulators]]<ref name="Defensive" /> [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] group<ref name="Codex Regulators">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=codex|The InterStellar Regulators}}</ref> who was active on<ref name="Defensive" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]]<ref name="Codex Regulators" /> in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Aida sector/Legends|Aida sector]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for the [[Makeb system/Legends|Makeb system]]</ref> by [[3638 BBY]].<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|2.0}}</ref> At one point, Z learned that their colleague [[Kerrin]] had nearly wiped the [[GH7 security matrix computer]]s of Makeb's [[Gravity hook|structure]] known as [[Gravity Hook Seven]]. The annoyed Z then wrote a memo to another colleague, rhetorically asking why the Regulators did not simply [[Death/Legends|kill]] Kerrin by ejecting him out of the [[Airlock/Legends|airlock]] of the [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] hook's [[Docking ring/Legends|docking ring]]. Worried about the security of Gravity Hook Seven, Z also asked their addressee to check the integrity of the backup defense database. The memo was then left on a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] on a [[Holotable/Legends|holotable]] in the gravity hook's [[Communications Bunker 72]].<ref name="Defensive" />

{{GameMechanics|Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel|legends=1}}
In 3638 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> an individual affiliated with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] [[Conquest of Makeb|entered]] the bunker and accessed the datapad, which contributed to them compromising Gravity Hook Seven's security.<ref name="Defensive" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Z was mentioned in [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel|''Rise of the Hutt Cartel'']], a [[2013]] expansion for the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Defensive" />
